# crates_info MCP tool

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-info/

One crate: score with its components, downloads, dependents, releases, MSRV, licence, advisories, rank overall and per category; live=true adds the live sparse-index record.

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "crates_info",
    "arguments": {
      "name": "<name>"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `live` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Input schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "live": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ]
}
```
